	13.	 Lee J. Dissociative catatonia: dissociative-catatonic reactions, clinical presentations and responses to benzodiazepines. Aust N Z J Psychiatry 
2011; 45:A42.

	19.	 Mazzone L, et al. Catatonia in patients with autism: prevalence and management. CNS Drugs 2014; 28:205–215.
